component.name: WE Manager
component.summary: Play Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on the Linux desktop

description.p: WE Manager is the control panel for Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on Linux. It browses the Steam Workshop, keeps a library of what you have with folders, tags and playlists, and plays it on your desktop with linux-wallpaperengine, which comes with the app.

ul.li: Scene, video and web wallpapers, one per screen or one for all of them
Workshop search with filters, subscribing, liking and favorites
A local library with folders, tags, filters for HDR and spatial audio, backups and extra library folders
Playlists with timers, and schedules by time of day or by light and dark theme
Wallpaper properties, layer and effect switches, scaling, image filters, volume and frame rate limits
Updates for itself and for the engine, and autostart at login

description.p: The wallpapers are drawn on KDE Plasma, wlroots compositors such as Hyprland, sway and niri, GNOME with the extension that is installed from the app, COSMIC and X11 desktops. Wallpaper Engine has to be in your Steam library for its assets and for the Workshop. Workshop items are made by other people and can be rated for mature audiences, the library has an age rating filter.
